stem: ![](asset:P000503-stem-1) The block of mass m initially at rest at x = 0 is acted upon by a horizontal force which, at position x, is given by $F = a - bx^{2}$ (where a > μmg), as shown in the figure. The co-efficient of friction between the surfaces of contact is μ. At what displacement will the mass ‘m’ be at momentary rest?

assets.alt: A block on a horizontal surface a distance x from a wall, with a horizontal force F_x acting on it away from the wall.
